biggest_catch: Real, actively maintained company — but FeaturePoints publishes no official points-to-cash conversion rate or minimum in any public source, and third-party figures openly contradict each other (600 pts=$1 vs 1,000 pts=$1 vs 3,000 pts=$5). There is no company-published payout term to verify.
catches: No official conversion rate or minimum published — the live rewards catalog is inside the account and its figures vary by country.
Third-party sources disagree on the rate, so no single figure can be cited honestly.
Points expire after 60 days of inactivity (per third-party reviews citing the policy) — unredeemed balances can vanish.
Company prohibits multiple accounts, VPNs/proxies — violations can mean permanent disablement and lost points.
Rewards are processed within ~5 business days per official support — payouts are not instant, and partner-verified offers can stay pending.

c1.evidence: FeaturePoints — active since 2012; support@featurepoints.com; 'Free Cash - FeaturePoints' live on Google Play, updated 16 Mar 2026, 10M+ downloads; featurepoints.com official site.

c2.evidence: FAILED — no concrete payout terms published by the company. Official Play listing names reward types (PayPal, Visa, Cash App, gift cards) and 'users have earned over £10 million' but no conversion rate or minimum. Third-party figures conflict, so none is authoritative.

c3.evidence: Free to join; no participation fee.

c4.evidence: Official company-authored Google Play listing obtained; confirms reward types and free participation but not a payout rate.

eligibility: Open signup; Android/iOS/web; one account per person; accurate profile details; age rules vary by country (check local signup terms).
notes: Legit and live (app updated March 2026), but rejected under the strict rule — same standard as the Nielsen rejection. If FeaturePoints ever publishes an official FAQ with conversion + minimum, this route can be re-verified quickly.
